name: Sarah Knafo - Après le § 11 - Am 3
title: REPORT on European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure
part_text: 11a. Emphasises that the supply of critical raw materials remains a strategic vulnerability, with the EU heavily dependent on third-country suppliers; underlines the key role of circularity and the recycling of critical materials for technological sovereignty and the need for an urgent scaling-up of domestic mining, refining and recycling capacities;
